text_original_1611: In the beginning God created the heauen and the earth.
text_modernized_spelling: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

text_original_1611: The words of the LORD are pure words: as siluer tried in a fornace of earth, purified seuen times.
text_modernized_spelling: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

text_original_1611: And Iosias held the feast of the Passeouer in Ierusalem unto his Lord, and offered the Passeouer the fourteenth day of the first moneth.
text_modernized_spelling: And Josias held the feast of the Passover in Jerusalem unto his Lord, and offered the Passover the fourteenth day of the first month.
